# The Capxul rebuild

*agreed, since 2026-11-15T17:20:00Z, by {"kind":"person","person":"aaron"}*

## Why

The product line drifted from its own description: facts were typed twice and nothing proved the system did what it said.

## What

Rebuild on one owner for every fact. The blueprint declares what Capxul does, the world says what runs where, and verdicts made by CI say what is proven.

## Where it ends

Capxul's own company runs a month on the rebuilt system in production, with every journey proven by CI and every measure watched.

## Not in this plan

New product features before the accounts pilot; anything on main or integration/build.

## Milestone 3: Foundations core (1 of 3 done, active)

**Goal.** One owner for every fact, checked: generated files, the seeded chain, the lint ratchet, machines, the delta check and the blueprint's format.

**Why now.** Everything later is declared in the blueprint first, so the blueprint and its checks must exist before any feature is built through it.

**Done when.** Steps 3.5, 3.6 and 3.8 are proven by verdicts on master.
